sample_unit: open-ended clinical questions (EHRNoteQA, MIMIC-IV discharge summaries)

links.outcome: Accuracy change from model self-critique and regeneration of flagged answers on clinical QA
links.effect: Self-critique pipeline improved accuracy for three of five open-source LLMs (p < 0.05) without parameter updates; no significant improvement for the other two.
links.quote: Experiments across five open-source LLMs-BioMistral, Llama-3.1, DeepSeek, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3, show that the self-critique strategy improves accuracy for three of five models (p < 0.05) without requiring parameter updates.
